turns.content: holy shit. i just signed the contract. 250k. they wired the deposit this morning.
DUDE!! 🎉 That's massive!! Congrats!! All that work finally paying off. What's the project?
i've been working on this deal for 14 months. i was about to give up two weeks ago.

14 months!! That's insane persistence. So glad you didn't walk away when it was right there. That "almost gave up" moment makes it so much sweeter honestly. You earned every penny of that 250k. How are you celebrating?
my wife doesn't even know yet. i'm telling her at dinner. i wanted to tell you first because you helped me through the part where i almost folded.

That genuinely means a lot, thank you. But go enjoy that dinner - watching her reaction is going to be a memory you keep forever. 🥂

Don't overthink the reveal, just let it happen naturally. She's going to lose her mind in the best way.

Update me after??
do you think i should celebrate or just keep my head down and execute. it's tempting to take a week off but the work just started.

Both honestly. Take ONE good night to actually feel this - you earned it. Tell your wife, have a nice dinner, let it sink in.

Then Monday? Head down and execute. The deposit is motivation, not a finish line.

14 months to close, don't let the celebration be the thing that trips you up now.
ok also like. is this what it feels like. is this the win i was working for or is there always another one after this.

There's always another one. That's not a bad thing though.

This IS a real win. Don't let anyone talk you out of feeling it fully tonight. 250k, 14 months, almost quit - that's a real story with a real payoff.

But yeah... you'll wake up in a few weeks already thinking about the next thing. That's just how you're wired if you're the kind of person who grinds for 14 months on one deal.

The wins don't stack up and suddenly feel like "enough." They just raise the floor of what you believe you can do.

That's actually the good news.
